integration_issues.issue: The clean-checkout-instruction rendered '0.00594382 ETH' (frontend-computed from getCurrencyRates) rather than the mocked addPayment 'amount:0.0061' field — mock's amount value is not consumed by the UI (UI derives it from live rate). Functional flow (layout, testids, timer, copy toggles, sticky bar) is unaffected, but review's expected literal '0.0061 ETH' will only appear if getCurrencyRates is ALSO mocked. Also raises the possibility that if page.route matching didn't intercept a Next.js-proxied addPayment (e.g. path differs), a real pool address could have been reserved — main agent should verify /api/pay/addPayment path exactly matches '**/api/pay/addPayment' in the actual XHR (open devtools Network tab or check backend logs for a reservation without a corresponding customer send).

action_items: (NON-BLOCKING) Verify the checkout amount rendering: either surface the mocked addPayment.amount field OR document that tests must mock /pay/getCurrencyRates when asserting a literal ETH amount.

(VERIFY) Confirm the frontend always sends company_id (query/body/x-company-id header) on /api/user/creator/stats and /analytics — otherwise it will show has_handle:false + zeros on a session whose last_company_id points to a handle-less brand.

(RETEST) Drag-and-drop overlay presence on the 6 surfaces beyond creator-cover-preview: the routes /products/new, /settings, /get-started, and 'Add brand' modal need explicit deep-links or intra-page navigation from the tester agent; on /storefront only creator-cover-preview is mounted, and on /products/new I hit a 404 'This page isn\'t available' — main agent should confirm the correct product-editor URL (product editor may live at /storefront > product-list > 'New product' rather than /products/new).

(RETEST) Sticky greeting header — my heuristic selector picked the wrong node; visual screenshot suggests the header sits at the top of the main-content scroll area, but a data-testid on the greeting box (e.g. main-page-header) would make this assertion deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveActiveCompanyId falls back to owned[0] (ascending company_id) when last_company_id is unset — for The Dev Store owner that is company 1 as intended, but any brand switch that fails to persist last_company_id will break stats/analytics. Consider persisting on every switch or resolving from a cookie the FE explicitly sets.

Frontend clean-checkout instruction uses live currency rate for the displayed amount rather than the amount returned by /api/pay/addPayment — either source of truth is defensible, but the two should agree so QA/test mocks stay meaningful. Suggest sourcing the rendered amount from addPayment.amount (server is authoritative) and using the rate only for the pre-reserve estimate.

Only creator-cover-preview was locatable on /storefront; the other 5 dropzone testids are gated behind sub-page navigation. Consider adding a lightweight audit test that visits each surface and asserts overlay wiring so regressions don't hide in less-trafficked flows.
Add data-testid='dash-greeting' or similar to the MainPageHeader so the sticky-header contract can be asserted deterministically.
